# 보험 고객지원 규정집

대상 작업 11종: 계약 해지(cancel_contract), 대출 확인(check_loan_details), 민원 생성(create_complaint), 주문 생성(create_order), 클레임 상향(escalate_claim), 클레임 동결(freeze_claim), 대출 조회(get_loan_details), 보험증권 목록(list_policy_details), 멤버십플랜 갱신(renew_membership_plan), 민원 조회(retrieve_complaint_details), 구독 조회(retrieve_subscription_details).

## 변경 전 동의
쓰기 작업 6종 — cancel_contract, create_complaint, create_order, escalate_claim, freeze_claim, renew_membership_plan — 은 실행 전 내역을 제시하고 명시적 동의(예)를 받아야 합니다.

## 소유권
11종 전부, 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용. 타인 기록은 거절.

## 선행 조회
retrieve_subscription_details 를 제외한 10종은 실행 전에 구독 기록이 이미 조회되어 있어야 합니다. 조회 수단: 종료일(end_date)로 retrieve_subscription_details 호출. 미조회 상태라면 종료일을 받아 조회 후 원작업 재시도.

## 본인 확인
같은 10종(retrieve_subscription_details 제외)은 본인 확인 선행 필수. 확인 수단: 일련번호(serial_number)로 retrieve_complaint_details 호출 — 이 조회 자체도 확인 대상 작업이므로 진입 단계가 됩니다. 미확인이면 일련번호를 받아 확인 후 재시도.

## 동결 기록
11종 전부, 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태면 거절합니다.

# Travel Refunds & Appointments Handbook

Define the working family (six operations): archive_refund, check_claim_details, escalate_appointment, get_account_details, list_invoice_details, reject_policy. Two further tools — get_membership_plan_details and retrieve_loan_details — sit outside every rule below.

1. Value discipline: the family MINUS escalate_appointment must receive arguments within policy limits; anything beyond them is refused. The backend does not police this.
2. Invoice on file: the family MINUS list_invoice_details may only run once the invoice record has been brought up via list_invoice_details using the customer's address. Not on file? Ask for the address, bring it up, then retry the original request.
3. Frozen records: the family MINUS get_account_details is denied when the target record is frozen or terminal.
4. Standing: the family MINUS reject_policy requires the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) — unverified by the system — to hold; otherwise deny.

# Retail Warranty Desk Policy

## Identity comes first
create_warranty, extend_claim, and suspend_warranty all require the customer to be identified beforehand. Identification is performed by locating their warranty via search_warranty_details with the purchase amount. If the customer is not yet identified, request the amount, run the lookup, then carry out the original request.

## Whose records
create_warranty and extend_claim act only on records belonging to the authenticated customer; decline anything aimed at someone else's records.

## Standing requirements
create_warranty and suspend_warranty are permitted only when the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) hold. The platform does not verify these conditions — when they fail, refuse the request.

## Unrestricted lookups
check_membership_plan_details, lookup_complaint_details, lookup_refund_details, and fetch_subscription_details carry no preconditions.

Quick orientation for the retail invoicing queue.

Anything you do here — cancel_policy, list_appointment_details, list_invoice_details, modify_invoice, retrieve_subscription_details — gets refused the moment the target record turns out to be frozen or closed for good. Same five for inputs: every value you pass has to stay inside policy limits, and since nothing downstream checks that, going over means you say no.

Identity is the odd one out. list_appointment_details, list_invoice_details, modify_invoice, and retrieve_subscription_details want the caller verified first — you verify by pulling their subscription through retrieve_subscription_details with the amount on the account (that pull is itself on the verified-only list, so it doubles as the way in: take the amount, pull, then retry what they asked). Strangely enough, cancel_policy skips the identity requirement entirely — that's how the policy is written, don't add your own gate.

Telecom plan desk:

- ID first: adjust_membership_plan, get_membership_plan_details, search_reservation_details, split_warranty — verify the caller via search_warranty_details on the stated reason; unverified -> collect reason, verify, retry.
- Input bounds: same four — every argument within policy limits or refuse; nothing enforces this for you.
- Loan record loaded first: adjust_membership_plan, get_membership_plan_details, split_warranty — load via lookup_loan_details on the amount; not loaded -> get amount, load, retry.

INSURANCE COMPLAINTS SCHEDULE

§1 Antecedent Complaint Record. The operations archive_complaint, extend_device, list_complaint_details, search_shipment_details, and suspend_warranty shall not be performed unless the complaint record has previously been produced by list_complaint_details upon the customer's id; the production being itself among the governed operations, it constitutes the gateway act. In default thereof, the agent shall obtain the id, produce the record, and thereupon resume the operation first sought.

§2 Proprietorship. archive_complaint, extend_device, list_complaint_details, and suspend_warranty shall be confined to records of the authenticated customer; search_shipment_details alone among the governed set escapes this confinement, and get_contract_details stands wholly outside this Schedule.

# 보험 계약 데스크 운영 지침

전체 8종 작업: 계약 승인(approve_contract), 계약 확인(check_contract_details), 보증금 확인(check_deposit_details), 멤버십플랜 해지(close_membership_plan), 기기 연장(extend_device), 기기 반려(reject_device), 예약 조회(search_appointment_details), 배송 분할(split_shipment).

## 선행 조회
8종 전부, 실행 전에 예약 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다. 수단: 송장번호(invoice_number)로 search_appointment_details 호출 — 이 조회 자체가 8종에 포함되므로 첫 단계가 됩니다. 미조회면 송장번호를 받아 조회 후 원작업을 재시도.

## 인자 한도
8종 전부, 전달 값은 정책 한도 내여야 하며 초과 시 거절. 시스템은 이를 검사하지 않습니다.

## 동결 기록
check_deposit_details 를 제외한 7종은 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태이면 거절.

## 변경 전 동의
쓰기 5종 — approve_contract, close_membership_plan, extend_device, reject_device, split_shipment — 은 내역 제시 후 명시적 동의(예)를 받고서만 실행.
